summary: The style source on the style-transfer endpoint: the picture whose palette, texture and rendering get applied to init_image. Its content is not copied across, only its look.
combines: Every side at least 64 px, at most 9,437,184 total pixels, aspect ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1, in jpeg, png or webp.
style_strength governs how strongly this image's look is applied. Lixpi pins it to 1, the maximum.
The AWS mirror repeats init_image's description verbatim for this field, which is wrong: this is the style reference, not the subject.
range: every side at least 64 px, total pixels at most 9,437,184, aspect ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1
